I also found a recursive `Inspect` bug: it re-evaluates the wrapper instead of the current subspec. I’m fixing that and checking the new streaming specs together.

from glom import *
from boltons.funcutils import *
from boltons.setutils import IndexedSet, complement
from boltons.dictutils import OneToOne, FastIterOrderedMultiDict
from boltons.iterutils import unique
import inspect, warnings
with warnings.catch_warnings():
 warnings.simplefilter('error')
 def f(a:int=1,*,b:str='x')->bool: return True
 b=FunctionBuilder.from_func(f)
 assert b.get_defaults_dict()=={'a':1,'b':'x'}
 assert inspect_formatargspec(*inspect.getfullargspec(f))=="(a: int=1, *, b: str='x') -> bool"
 assert b.get_func()()
assert set() - IndexedSet([1]) == set()
assert set([1,2]) - IndexedSet([1]) == {2}
assert {1,2} - complement({2}) == {2}
s=IndexedSet([1,2,3]); s.difference_update([1],[2]); assert list(s)==[3]
d=OneToOne([('a',1),('b',1),('c',2)]); del d['b']; assert d.inv[1]=='a'; del d['a']; assert d.inv=={2:'c'}
m=FastIterOrderedMultiDict([('a',1),('b',1),('a',2)])
assert list(m.items(multi=True)) == [('a',1),('b',1),('a',2)]
assert unique([1,2,1])==[1,2]
assert glom({'x':3}, Fill({'value':T['x'],'literal':'x','auto':Auto('x')}))=={'value':3,'literal':'x','auto':3}
assert glom({'x':3}, (Let(v='x'), S.v))==3
assert glom([1,2,3,4], Iter().filter(lambda x:x%2==0).chunked(2).flatten().all())==[2,4]
assert glom([1,2,3,4], Iter().dropwhile(lambda x:x<3).first())==3
assert glom([], Iter().first(default='empty'))=='empty'
assert glom({'x':3}, Inspect(Auto('x'),echo=False,recursive=True))==3
assert glom({'x':3}, Inspect(Inspect('x',echo=False,recursive=True),echo=False,recursive=True))==3
assert glom([1,2], (Iter(Check(type=int)),list))==[1,2]
print('public API smoke checks passed')
